submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.0368%) at Sb fraction 0.33. EQE falls on both sides: 0.0081 at 0.264, 0.0309 at 0.362, 0.0111 at 0.502 (the Pb2Sb2O7 composition) and 0.00025 at 0.657 (PbSb2O6). So the maximum lies in the Pb-rich region around Sb 0.31–0.36.
